providers.description: Aletheia's own Python modules, run locally or in CI
GitHub Actions in this repo executing on schedule or push
GitHub REST API via aletheia.gh (FLEET_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN)
ChatGPT app (subscription): voice/text interface + GitHub connector writes
Claude Code sessions (subscription): builds and maintains Aletheia and the fleet

capabilities.description: Resolve the fleet registry: repos, roles, agents, watch lists, front-door grants
Observe every fleet repo: commits, workflows, state files, vitals, transitions, alerts
capabilities.verification: pulse names every registry repo or records why not
capabilities.notes: AVAILABLE for this repo and local clones today; full-fleet telemetry needs the FLEET_TOKEN secret

capabilities.description: Compose the morning digest with day-over-day deltas and deliver via rolling issue
Notice health transitions; open/comment/close the rolling fleet-alert issue
Durable append-only memory: decisions, events, actions, notes
capabilities.caller: every capability that acts; CLI for operator notes

capabilities.description: Search the memory by term, kind, or recency
Goals as tracked data: open plans, steps with states, journaled lifecycle
capabilities.caller: CLI, intercom plan_* commands; surfaced by pulse/brief/wall

capabilities.description: Durable task engine: lifecycle, dependencies, retries surviving restarts
capabilities.caller: CLI (aletheia.tasks); intercom wiring is the next milestone

capabilities.description: Run a fleet repo's workflow through its front door
capabilities.notes: gated by front_door in config/fleet.json — default grants only Aletheia's own workflows

capabilities.description: File an issue on a fleet repo
Record a ruling on a ChatGPT suggestion (doing/not_doing/later/in_progress/done)
Operator speaks to ChatGPT (voice/text, no API keys); commands relayed as JSON, executed through registry gates, receipts written back
capabilities.verification: every command gets a committed .result.json receipt
capabilities.notes: executor built and tested (15 command kinds incl. halt/resume/approve/deny/remember/tasks); needs the operator to create the ChatGPT Project per exchange/INTERCOM.md

capabilities.description: Hand a durable task to an AI worker (Claude builds; ChatGPT reviews/authors) and track it
capabilities.caller: director in pulse.yml: files approval-gated work orders for READY assigned tasks
capabilities.notes: dispatch half is built+tested; EXPERIMENTAL until the first live round-trip (worker completes a work order with evidence). Worker wake-up is still each app's own scheduled tasks.

capabilities.description: Operate the Windows PC: observe, open apps, click, type (accessibility-first)
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phase 7 (Playbook §121), Core V0 code is shipped — needs it RUNNING on the PC

capabilities.description: Drive a dedicated authenticated browser profile: navigate, read, fill, extract
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phase 8 (Playbook §122), Core V0 code is shipped — needs it RUNNING on the PC

capabilities.description: Place and hold a phone conversation on the operator's behalf (identifies itself as Aletheia)
capabilities.caller: ticket — Phone V0 (Playbook §17): desktop call app + virtual audio + ChatGPT Voice, local PC only

capabilities.description: Room voice: local wake word ('Thea'), spoken requests into the same Core
Draft and send email with approval gate
Read availability, reason about work hours and buffers
Unified device layer (Home Assistant or equivalent): lights, scenes, media
The kill switch: halt suspends every acting capability until an operator resume
capabilities.caller: intercom halt/resume commands, CLI; enforced in act + intercom + director

capabilities.description: Durable approval objects: requested as issues or by workers, decided by owner comment or by voice
capabilities.caller: director (delegate gate), approvals.yml on owner comments, intercom approve/deny, CLI

capabilities.description: Deterministic goal-to-tasks compiler with evidence-gated completion (a step is done only when its task completed WITH evidence)
Structured memory with provenance (identity/preferences/people/organizations); corrections overwrite but record what they replaced
capabilities.caller: intercom remember commands, CLI, Claude sessions

capabilities.description: Recall a memory and answer 'why do you think that' from provenance
capabilities.caller: CLI; ChatGPT reads memory/ raw for reference resolution

capabilities.description: The local Core V0: persistent service on the operator's PC — internal API (/api/*), the wall at /, Command Center at /command.html; loopback-only until authentication exists
capabilities.caller: operator runs `python -m aletheia.core` on the Windows PC; Command Center + wall are its clients
capabilities.verification: GET /api/status; 7 tests in test_core.py incl. live HTTP round-trips
capabilities.notes: code built and tested in CI; NEEDS_CONFIGURATION = the operator starting it on the PC

agents.description: Builds and maintains Aletheia and the fleet; the only worker that edits code
agents.limitations: woken by sessions/scheduled tasks, not yet by Aletheia itself

agents.description: Thea's voice and advisor; relays operator commands, reviews, researches
